steps.en: Add the Swift package to your iOS/macOS app (iOS/macOS 26.4+)
steps.zh: 把 Swift 包加进你的 iOS/macOS 应用（系统需 26.4+）

component.zh: 预编译 uzu 二进制

steps.en: Create an engine and ask for a model by its catalog id
steps.zh: 创建引擎，按目录 id 要一个模型

steps.en: Looks the id up in Mirai's hosted registry, filtered to builds that fit this device
steps.zh: 到 Mirai 托管的模型目录查这个 id，只给本机能跑的版本

steps.en: Start the download and show its progress
Fetches the pre-converted weights from Hugging Face and caches them on the device
steps.zh: 从 Hugging Face 拉取已转换好的权重，缓存在设备上

steps.en: Open a chat session and send the messages
steps.zh: 开一个对话会话，发出消息

steps.en: Runs the model on the Apple GPU with its Metal kernels and returns reasoning and text
steps.zh: 用自带的 Metal 内核在苹果 GPU 上跑模型，返回推理过程和正文

value.en: A language model answers inside your app on the user's device — no server to run, no per-token bill
value.zh: 语言模型在用户设备上、在你的应用里直接作答：不用自建服务，也没有按 token 计费

sources: https://github.com/trymirai/uzu/blob/main/crates/legacy/uzu/src/registry/mirai/registry.rs (fetch/models from sdk.trymirai.com with device + backends; HF resolution)
